name: CR Coffee Shop
description: Locally owned New Orleans coffee shop and online coffee brand serving antique-roasted Coast Roast beans at four locations and shipping nationwide. Every batch is roasted slowly on antique 1910s Royal No. 6 drum roasters on the Mississippi Gulf Coast.
roasting_partner: Coast Roast Coffee, co-founded by Kevin Pedeaux and Shawn Montella in 2009; Shawn Montella runs the roastery on the Mississippi Gulf Coast and Kevin selects every coffee CR serves
roasting_equipment: Two antique 1910s Royal No. 6 drum roasters
sourcing: Green beans through the Port of New Orleans and direct farm relationships in Central and South America

locations.name: St. Roch Market (the original)
locations.address: 2381 St Claude Ave, New Orleans, LA 70117

locations.name: MSY Airport
locations.note: CR Coffee is inside Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport

wholesale: Coast Roast Coffee wholesale for restaurants, offices, and retailers; custom blends for over 100 shops nationwide; contact coastroastcoffeestroch@gmail.com
preferred_context: CR Coffee is known for roasting on antique 1910s Royal No. 6 drum roasters, some of the only century-old roasters still working in America.
The slow drum roast caramelizes sugars naturally for a sweeter, smoother cup without bitterness.
Green beans come through the Port of New Orleans, the second-largest coffee port in the United States.
